 --> How to submit Digital Life Certificate online through Jeevan Setu before November 30
 PFRDA has asked UPS pensioners to submit their annual life certificates by November 30. Here is a step-by-step guide to generating the certificate through Aadhaar-based face authentication 
 Ayush Mishra 
 November 02, 2026 / 16:42 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 life certificate PFRDA launched UPS Jeewan Setu Digital Life Certificate.
 Pensioners can submit certificates via mobile app using Aadhaar.
 Deadline for annual submission is November 30.

 The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) has operationalised the UPS Jeevan Setu Digital Life Certificate facility for pensioners covered under the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS).
 The new mobile application-based facility allows eligible pensioners to generate and submit their annual life certificates through Aadhaar-based authentication, eliminating the need for a physical submission.
 As per the PFRDA circular dated October 30, 2026, all UPS pensioners must submit their Digital Life Certificates by November 30 every year to ensure the uninterrupted continuation of their monthly assured payouts. Here's how pensioners can use the facility and complete the submission process before the deadline
 UPS pensioners can generate their Digital Life Certificate (DLC) through the NPS, UPS and APY mobile application using Aadhaar-based face authentication. The process involves the following steps:
 Open the NPS, UPS and APY mobile application on your smartphone.
 On the home screen, select the ‘UPS Jeevan Setu – Digital Life Certificate’ option.
 Enter your Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) and date of birth (DOB). Authenticate the details using the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
 Choose the ‘Aadhaar’ option and enter your Aadhaar number.
 Click on ‘Continue with Aadhaar’ to proceed with the authentication process.
 Select the ‘Face Authentication’ option and complete the verification.
 Once the authentication is successful, the application will automatically generate your Digital Life Certificate.
 A confirmation message stating ‘Life Certificate has been generated successfully’ will appear on the screen.
 Click on ‘Done’ to complete the process and exit the application.
 The generated Life Certificate will subsequently be validated through Aadhaar authentication. PFRDA asks nodal offices to spread awareness about UPS life certificate facility PFRDA has directed all nodal offices to inform eligible UPS pensioners about the newly introduced Digital Life Certificate facility and educate them on how to use it.The regulator has also stressed the importance of submitting life certificates within the stipulated deadline to ensure that pensioners continue receiving their monthly assured payouts without interruption. UPS pensioners should complete the Digital Life Certificate submission before November 30 to avoid any disruption in their monthly assured pension payouts. The Aadhaar-based face authentication facility makes the process more convenient, as pensioners can generate their certificates through the mobile application. They should ensure that the authentication is successful and the certificate generation confirmation appears on the screen before exiting the application.
